from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    # Exclude separator lines to identify the background color.
    interior = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in sep_cols
    ]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    counts = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            r0, r1 = row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1]
            row.append(sum(
                grid[r][c] != background
                for r in range(r0, r1)
                for c in range(c0, c1)
            ))
        counts.append(row)

    freq = Counter(x for row in counts for x in row)
    common = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[int(x != common) for x in row] for row in counts]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]

    # The most frequent color in the non-separator cells is the tile background.
    cells = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in sep_cols
    ]
    background = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    counts = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges) - 1):
            r0, r1 = row_edges[ri] + 1, row_edges[ri + 1]
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci] + 1, col_edges[ci + 1]
            row.append(sum(
                grid[r][c] != background
                for r in range(r0, r1)
                for c in range(c0, c1)
            ))
        counts.append(row)

    frequencies = Counter(value for row in counts for value in row)
    usual_count = frequencies.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[int(value != usual_count) for value in row] for row in counts]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    background = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in sep_cols
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])
            ]
            n = sum(v != background for v in cells)
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background if n == 1 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
